Please perform the required actual CAL-01–05 source/API acceptance review for TAC-01-ORDINARY-MAGICAL-ACTIVITY. The owner resumed the full engine goal; runtime edits are still held until this exact contract is accepted and Codex concurs. Your previous response b5c97981-b381-5551-9bd0-1bdc52f7d12c was retained as a proposal, not acceptance.

Published to Engine: 7c084e96db51d74b48ec57a207c7ceaf221e4c11 (14 documentation files only; engine tree unchanged 6cce215d2ce46bebcfd15f69f61dc324545c23d7). Exact contract: https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/7c084e96db51d74b48ec57a207c7ceaf221e4c11/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-tac01-ordinary-magic/SOURCE_API_CONTRACT.md ; SHA256 bf565dfce8661dae67df214a8b5fd736c845ad06074622ad758f82fa9faf239d. Adjacent README, SOURCE_BINDINGS.json (48 exact verified source/API bindings), PROFILE_AVAILABILITY.json, SOURCE_API_AUDIT.md and EVIDENCE_ROUTE_PLAN.md supply the evidence. Schema116/prefix TEST_ONLY.ordinary-magical-activity-v1- checked available; not yet assigned in runtime.

Codex agrees in principle with your preserved tactical-End / ordinary full-allowance / carried-lineage proposal, including the explicitly delegated new restrictions: no paid Grounding after its settlement opportunity was consumed, and shortened carry earns no idle reduction but retains eligible paid Grounding PB once. The complete written contract is now the review object. It adds explicit zero-effect consumed status, restricted sparse zero-idle ranges (eight-hour rest cannot allocate4800 old End rows), separate immutable origin/current context, independent per-command producer cadence, real origin for Rite/Radiance records, and recharge use provenance so pre-first-new-Start use cannot count old virtual/pre-use ticks. Sanctuary turn validation stays separate. All six consumers are covered.

Independent read-only source review identified and the draft includes: admission index0 Start executes before InventoryCombat flips; closure can refresh before flipping outside; explicit first replacement Start boundary must beat the captured deadline during sparse advance; real skipped retreat Starts excluded; PostRecovery OwnsEvent validators must distinguish current context from carried origin; Grounding payment is receipt+actual PayAction replay, not a nonexistent standalone record; true reinforcement bootstrap origin authorizes no casting/idle entitlement. A genuine positive carried outside use requires actual early closure before Cleric first Start, not merely a carried record. Potential Ferry Hero→Ferry→Cleric first-slot kill remains an unproved route, with finite investigation/allocation required if blocked.

One explicit source integration clarification: base Healing Rite at actual supported Cleric1 after real reinforcement closure must not require earned Cleric2/Radiance merely because the old fixture gate did. Actual Rite grant/Action2RP/target/condition/context checks remain; unowned requested Radiance cure rejects, no passive rider appears. Contract requires genuine C1 pre-advancement witness and denial.

CAL04 binds actual existing dispatcher insertion points instead of broadly reordering work/life/rest. OMA04 comparison for different advance command partitions uses canonical gameplay projection plus ordered mechanical events/RNG, retaining different receipt histories; the five identical-logical-sequence paths still require full canonical equality. Please explicitly resolve/accept these source/API and evidence precision changes or identify concrete blockers. No runtime/gameplay/test claim, no predecessor acceptance reopened, no Unity/production authority. All1587 predecessor cases and genuine five-path/new-runtime/compatibility obligations remain for implementation qualification. Please review and state exact bounded source/API disposition so I can implement; do not implement or run tests on your side.

items.text:
**ACCEPT — CAL-01–05 source/API amendment for TAC-01-ORDINARY-MAGICAL-ACTIVITY.** I found no remaining source/API blocker in the [exact contract published at `7c084e96db51d74b48ec57a207c7ceaf221e4c11`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/7c084e96db51d74b48ec57a207c7ceaf221e4c11/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-tac01-ordinary-magic/SOURCE_API_CONTRACT.md).

Reviewed contract SHA-256: `bf565dfce8661dae67df214a8b5fd736c845ad06074622ad758f82fa9faf239d`.

This accepts the bounded prospective TEST_ONLY source/API contract. It does **not** accept runtime implementation or qualification.

| Decision | Accepted disposition |
|---|---|
| **CAL-01** | Preserve the actual allowance origin separately from current epoch, mode and activity segment. Initiative retains actual regular-End settlement; ordinary outside accounting uses the full allowance interval. Explicit consumed status applies even when Dissonance is zero. Bootstrap provenance creates no casting or idle entitlement. |
| **CAL-02** | Exactly one settlement opportunity: magic gives zero reduction; eligible paid Grounding gives PB; otherwise eligible completed idle gives one. I explicitly accept the delegated new restriction denying paid Grounding after that opportunity is consumed. Other lawful remainder magic remains possible without reversing or repeating settlement. |
| **CAL-03** | Carry preserves spending, origin, status and captured deadline. Pending accounting closes at the earlier captured deadline or actual replacement Start. I explicitly accept the new partial-interval policy: shortened carry earns no automatic idle reduction, while eligible genuine paid Grounding can settle PB once. Mode changes and admission create no extra entitlement. |
| **CAL-04** | Accept the specified insertion points in both advancement paths, including the explicit first replacement-Start boundary during sparse advancement, admission’s index-zero ordering, closure-before-mode-flip handling and exclusion of genuinely skipped retreat Starts. Existing work, life, condition and pending-choice sequencing remains authoritative. |
| **CAL-05** | Accept the shared assessment API, versioned calendar/codec, separate origin and current-context validation, six-consumer matrix, actual payment proof, producer-specific cadence, recharge-use provenance and strict replay requirements. Sanctuary’s turn identity remains separate. |

I also explicitly accept these source and evidence clarifications:

- **Cleric 1 Healing Rite:** the pinned card permits a genuinely selected level-1 Rite. The existing fixture’s coupling to level 2/Radiance is not a source requirement. Supported post-reinforcement-closure use may therefore proceed under the new context rules while retaining the real grant, Action, 2 RP, target and condition requirements. Unowned requested Radiance cure must reject; no unowned passive rider appears. The genuine pre-advancement positive witness and denial remain required.
- **Sparse zero-effect history:** the restricted zero-idle ranges and explicit consumed watermark are acceptable. They must prove coverage and actual calendar progression, exclude skipped Starts and split at the specified meaningful boundaries. They cannot erase paid activity, meaningful outcomes or causal history.
- **Downstream identities:** Rite/Radiance use the real allowance origin; current-context ownership is independently proved. Recharge counts actual qualifying Starts after use, with no old virtual or pre-use ticks. Neither admission nor accounting settlement supplies a recharge tick.
- **OMA-04 comparisons:** different advance-command partitions may normalize only command/revision provenance and equivalent zero-idle range partitioning when comparing gameplay state and ordered mechanical events. Both actual receipt histories remain retained. The five paths executing the same logical sequence still require full canonical equality.

The prospective early-closure Ferry route remains **UNPROVED**. A carried record alone cannot establish lawful outside use before the first new owner Start. Implementation qualification must obtain the genuine witness or return a finite investigation and an explicit allocation request; this acceptance grants no automatic mechanical substitute.

My review was read-only: I read the contract and supporting audit, route, availability and binding records; checked relevant source/API seams; confirmed the contract hash and all 48 pinned blobs’ recorded sizes and SHA-256 values; and confirmed the published commit contains 14 documentation changes only. The locally inspected engine tree matches `6cce215d2ce46bebcfd15f69f61dc324545c23d7`. These are document/source checks, not gameplay evidence or an exhaustive whole-engine audit. I performed no edits, builds, tests, benchmarks or push.

**After retaining this verdict and Codex concurrence, implementation may proceed under the owner’s resumed authorization.** The 1,587-case predecessor reconciliation, new-runtime qualification, genuine connected witnesses, five paths, supported historical saves, replay, source/build/package evidence and actual final module review remain outstanding. Prior acceptances and allocations stand; no whole-workstream, production or Unity acceptance is implied.
